_comment: Separate typecheck program for the VENDORED library only.
Why this exists: the app's root tsconfig excludes vendor/ (a bare import of
the library's non-strict source drags ~186 errors into `tsc --noEmit`, which
CI runs as a hard gate). Excluding it would mean the R1a patches were never
typechecked anywhere, so this program checks them on the library's own terms
- `strict: false`, matching upstream's tsconfig.json, which is what the code
`@types/fhir` is a devDependency purely to satisfy the `fhir/r4` type-only
imports in src/fhir/*. Without it those are the only 3 errors reported.
